title: watchface shows a question mark instead of a trend arrow
body:
since the update to 3.2 (both release candidates and master branch), the AAPS watchface often shows a question mark instead of a trend arrow. I have not yet been able to identify a pattern of when this occurs, but it happens with all possible trend directions. It can be that it works in between times for half an hour or so as predicted but then there is again a question mark. See attached picture.


![watchface](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/assets/62606176/f85dd0c5-4870-4d78-9411-293165d12cfb)

comments.body: Can you replace AAPS (Digital) by AAPS (custom) watchface (default one or any other one) and send a screenshot?

I think your issue comes from phone side (trend Arrow sent to the watch is "invalid"...)
You will probably have to provide log file to see if we find something in it...
How do you get BG values ?
through xDrip (dexcom G7). I sent the log through email. Thanks in advance

I don't receive log sent by mail. copy it here if you want me to take a look
But because it's on phone side, I'm not sure I will be able to find root cause without @MilosKozak

@MilosKozak
